text: The colony: the ship's parts set down on the world, one by one, and what the world gives built up around them.

builds.name: Farm
builds.text: Fields under clear sheeting, watered from whatever the world has. Every day it grows what the soil and water allow.

builds.name: Mine
builds.text: A shaft and a headframe over the best seam the landing found. Every day it brings up what the ore allows.

builds.name: Solar array
builds.text: Panels on frames, tilted at the star, with cells to carry them through the night. Power that stays when the ship flies.

builds.name: Shelter
builds.text: A sealed hut of mine-cut panels: two bunks and a scrubber, for whoever stays home.

buildings.name: Power plant
buildings.text: The ship's reactor on a slab of its own, humming. It runs everything the colony plugs in.

buildings.name: Generator
buildings.text: A small reactor in a shed. Enough to keep the lights on and the air moving.

buildings.name: Air plant
buildings.text: Scrubbers and fans, breathing for a settlement now instead of a ship.

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.text: The crew quarters, set down whole: four bunks and a door that sticks.

buildings.name: Bunkhouse
buildings.text: Two bunks with their own little air plant, for a crew short of room.

buildings.name: Storehouse
buildings.text: A cargo hold on legs. Empty for now; the colony will fill it.

buildings.name: Warehouse
buildings.text: The big hold, out under the sky. It will take all the colony makes.

buildings.name: Infirmary
buildings.text: The med bay, with a proper floor under it. It patches the crew up between scrapes.

buildings.name: Clinic
buildings.text: Surgery, set down where nobody falls out of a hull breach mid-stitch.

buildings.name: Armory
buildings.text: The ship's gun racks, kept where the crew can reach them when a raid comes.

buildings.name: Gun emplacement
buildings.text: A weapon mount bolted to the ground and pointed at the sky.

buildings.name: Cannon emplacement
buildings.text: A ship's cannon dug in and aimed up. Anything coming down will think twice.

buildings.name: Flak tower
buildings.text: Point defense up a tower, for whatever falls from the sky faster than it should.

buildings.name: Shield dome
buildings.text: A shield generator throwing its field over the rooftops.

buildings.name: Shield array
buildings.text: The big shield array, with the whole colony under it.
